titleShort: auto-panic: chromatika-team detected active drain pattern
bodyLong: A drain pattern targeting policy-vault dWallets was detected in the wild. chromatika-team is publishing this alert with panicTargets populated for the affected vaults. When your chromatika instance verifies this alert and the active vault id matches, the on-chain panic flag will flip automatically. Unfreeze takes effect after the configured delay; until then the MPC network refuses ALL signing.
